 Earthquake with preliminary magnitude of 5.7 strikes Japan 
 A strong earthquake with a preliminary reading of magnitude 5.7 has struck central Japan 
 By The Associated Press November 7, 2026, 6:24 PM 
 1:27 TOKYO -- A strong earthquake with a preliminary reading of magnitude 5.7 struck central Japan early Sunday, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency. Japanese media reported dozens of injuries.
 A wide area near Aichi Prefecture was affected and smaller aftershocks have followed.
